meta.engine: A (route A: exact simplex/Schwinger generating functions)
meta.unit: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2)
meta.status_labels: derived-from-construction (every number from the master formula, Upsilon = [eps^0] of the defect cycles); computed by one engine (route A); comparison with route B open

OP0.lines: P_b, M_Om, R: [x.,Q^GF] = [x.,H] = 0 => x. commutes with P*, E => [Q,P* x. P*] = 0; Delta: scalar identity above; K_b: [v.,P*]E - [v.,E]P* != 0 since C_K != 0

generators.D0: Delta, intrinsic part at x_O = 0 (position part = 2 x_O^mu Upsilon_{P_mu}, G-pos)
generators.xi: xi in S_+ (x) W (engine lam_+ basis, coefficients [1, 2, -1, 1, 0, 1, -2, 1])
generators.xibar: xibar in S_- (x) W^* (engine lam_- basis, same coefficients)
generators.eta0: eta in S_+ (x) W^* (engine lams_+), intrinsic part (position part = x_O^mu Upsilon_{rho(e_mu) eta})
generators.etabar0: etabar in S_- (x) W (engine lams_-), intrinsic part

tfix.two-component: residual freedom multiplies the one-loop actions of Q^i_alpha, Qbar_{alphadot i}, S^alpha_i, Sbar^{alphadot i}, P_m, K_m by 1-(a-c/2), 1-(-a-c/2), 1-(-a+c/2), 1-(a+c/2), 1+c, 1-c (Rem op-tc-main)

Delta (at x_O; v. = 2 x.d + 2w).A|_V: -(22/3 + theta_V (2w + 2x.d)) X  (+ kappa_V: s-exact, zero on cohomology)
Delta (at x_O; v. = 2 x.d + 2w).action values: theta_perp = theta_lambda = theta_V = -1/3 (Ob^(2)(Delta,P_b), Thm at-theta; both action engines)

P_b.X in sector d: -thetaP_d d_b X (Ob^(1)(P_b)|_2 = 0; theta_P free, fixed up to a B + (c/2) lambda by the arity-two relations)

M_Om.A|_V: -(1/3 spin_Om + thetaM_V M_Om.) A_V  (spin term from both action engines)
M_Om.lambda: -(m_lambda spin_Om + thetaM_lambda M_Om.) lambda; m_lambda = 1/3 (engine B: S(M)_spin includes lambda), engine A: -1/12 int(rho(Om) lam, dslash lam) without preimage normalisation (FLAGGED, both kept)

xi (both chiralities).A|_V: -(p + thetaXi_V) Gamma(xi, lam)|_V-arrow: -(p + thetaXi_V) xi.A_V, p = log(3/2) - 79/12
xi (both chiralities).lambda: -(thetaXi_V xi.|_{rho(dA_V)} + thetaXi_perp xi.|_{rho(dA_perp)}) lambda (T1, T2 carry no lambda*)
xi (both chiralities).outer direction G_B: -a B: -a on S_+ (x) W, +a on S_- (x) W^* (times the classical action)

eta.all letters: not provided by the action side (Ob^(1)(eta)|_2 intrinsic only): unknown one-body map F_eta

K_b.all letters: not provided by the action side (T7 open): unknown one-body map F_K

components.M_1: two-body 0 (Upsilon^0_M = 0 on the two-output leg set); one-body -thetaM_perp M_Om.O; position part (Om x_O)^mu P_1|_{P_mu}
components.R_1: two-body 0; one-body -thetaR_perp R.O (Ob^(1)(R) = 0: the direction is free; R8: removable by psi)
components.S_1: two-body: Q_1 two-body along the Killing spinor rho(x_O) eta (position part, G-pos graph by graph) + Upsilon^0_eta, whose only two-letter leg set on (A_perp, A_perp) is a single lam (zero on the colour singlet); one-body -{hbar F_1^(1)(eta), O}: not provided by the action side (open)
components.K_1: two-body: v(x_O)^mu P_1|_{P_mu} - (b,x_O) D^0_1 + M^0_1|_{omega_xO} + K^0_1 (G-pos); Upsilon^0_K(A_perp,A_perp) on (none): 0, on A_V: zero on the singlet; one-body -{hbar F_1^(1)(K_b), O}: not provided by the action side (open)
components.one-body inputs:
(step2/strict/action/engine_a/results.json, engine_b/results.json; read only through the one-body
interface):
  Delta:  Ob^(1)(Delta)|_2 = -11/3 int(dA,dA) [A_V and A_perp] + 47/3 int(lam,dslash lam) - 14/3 int(dc,A*)
          = 4 s(u N)|_2 + u[1/3, -1/3, -2/3]  (lc^(0)|_2 = s(uN)|_2 = u[-1, 4, -1]: both engines),
          theta^Delta_perp = theta^Delta_lambda = theta^Delta_V = -1/3 (fixed by Ob^(2)(Delta,P_b), Thm at-theta; both
          engines).  Particular solution on two legs: hbar F_1^(1)(Delta)|_2 = 4 u N + y_A int(A,A*) + y_lam int(lam*,lam)
          + y_c int(c*,c) with Q-images fixed by Q N|_2 = [-1, 4, -1]: Q int(A,A*) -> -1/2 on int(dA,dA),
          Q int(lam*,lam) -> -1 on int(lam,dslash lam); hence y_A = -2/3, y_lam = 1/3 (no sign ambiguity), and on the
          ghost line y_A a_3 + y_c c_3 = -2/3 with 2 a_3 - c_3 = -1: (a_3, c_3) = (-1, -1) [Q A = -dc, Q c* = d*A*]
          gives y_c = 4/3 (flagged: the ghost one-body constant depends on this sign; alternative (0, 1): y_c = -2/3).
          Brackets {N, X} = n_F(X) X, n_F = 1, 2, 4, -2, -4, -1 on c, A, lam, A*, lam*, c*;
          {int(A,A*), A} = A, {int(lam*,lam), lam} = -lam, {int(c*,c), c} = -c (from N).
          One-body on a letter X of sector d and Weyl weight w (derivatives included), at the point x_O = 0:
             -{hbar F_1^(1)(Delta), X} = -(phi_d + theta_d (2w + 2 x_O.d)) X,
             phi_A = 8 - 2/3 = 22/3,  phi_lam = 16 - 1/3 = 47/3,  phi_c = 4 - 4/3 = 8/3 (flagged),  antifields -phi;
          kappa_V, kappa_lam directions are s-exact: zero on cohomology, carried as symbols.
  P_b:    Ob^(1)(P_b)|_2 = 0: hbar F_1^(1)(P_b)|_2 = theta_P (sector parts of S^(1)(P_b)) (free):
             -{hbar F_1^(1)(P_b), X} = -theta_{P,d} d_b X.
  M_Om:   hbar F_1^(1)(M_Om)|_2 = 1/3 u int Om_{mu nu}(A_mu, A*_nu) [spin, A|_V] + lambda spin part (preimage of
          -1/12 int(rho(Om) lam, dslash lam), coefficient m_lam, derived -1/3 relative to the classical spin action,
          flagged) + theta_M sector parts:  -{.., X} = -(m_d spin_Om X + theta_{M,d} M_Om.X).
  R:      Ob^(1)(R) = 0 (both engines): hbar F_1^(1)(R) = theta_R sector parts: -theta_{R,d} R.X.
  xi:     hbar F_1^(1)(xi)|_2 = (log(3/2) - 79/12)(T1 + T2) + u(theta^xi_V S^V_2(xi) + theta^xi_perp S^perp_2(xi))
          (+ beta-shifts {N_f, S_2(xi)}, outer direction G_B: a B), both chiralities; on A|_perp letters only T2
          (and S^perp_2) act: {S^perp_2(xi), A_perp} = {S^(1)(xi), A_perp}.
  eta, K_b: not prov

twocomp.orientation: dictionary orientation (S_+ = undotted for dx^1 dx^2 dx^3 dx^4); engine A labels mirrored, numbers identical by the reflection symmetry
twocomp.O: int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A) = 1/16 int omega (w1^{ij} A_ij, w2^{kl} A_kl)
twocomp.F1: int omega [(iota_w1 A, (rho(w2) xi, lam)) + (1<->2)] = 1/4 int omega [(w1^{kl} A_kl, w2_{ji} xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + (1<->2)]
twocomp.F2: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_perp) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (A_{ji}, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j)
twocomp.F3: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_V) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)
twocomp.F4: (w1,w2) int omega (c, (xi, lam^*)) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (c, xi_alpha^i lam^{*alpha}_i)
twocomp.classical: {S^(1)(xi), O} = +F1  (A_ij -> +Gamma(xi,lam)_ij, Gamma_kl(xi, lam) = -2 eps_{jikl} (xi^j lam^i), dictionary entry Gamma; Cor c7-Q)
twocomp.Q1_two_body_psi0: Q_1(O)|_two-body = (2*log2 - 2*log3) F1 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F2 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F3 + (0) F4  units u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2)  (psi = 0)
twocomp.c_Q: Q_1(O)|_traceless = c_Q {S^(1)(xi), O}, c_Q = 79/12 - 3 log(3/2) - theta^xi_perp (particular solution (log(3/2) - 79/12)(T1+T2) of the action side)
twocomp.trace_psi0: Q_1(O)|_trace, two-body (psi = 0) = (-4*log2 + 4*log3) (1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij) int omega [(A_ji, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)]
twocomp.Konishi: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha lam_alpha^i, A_ij z^j) ) contains 0 x int omega (lambdabar_{alphadot i} z^i, lambdabar^{alphadot}_j z^j): c_K = 0 (psi = 0)
twocomp.bc_lamstar: Q_1( int omega (c, u_alpha lam^{*alpha}_4) ) on lambdabar_{alphadot 4} lambdabar^{alphadot}_4: 0
twocomp.betabeta: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha lam_alpha^I, u'^beta lam_beta^J) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{K4}), K the complement of I, J: nonzero, holomorphic derivatives d_alphadot = u'^alpha sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} d_m only, the same coefficient for both colour orders (per unit weight-vector letters 2/3 on d^{alphadot} gamma^K lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, modulo the Q^xi_0-exact Dirac component)
twocomp.bgamma: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha F_mn (sigma^m sigmabar^n)_alpha^beta u'_beta, A_{I4}) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{I4}): nonzero, holomorphic derivatives only; modulo Im Q^xi_0 the two colour orders have unequal coefficients containing log(3/2) (engine weight-vector normalisation 64/3 - 128 log(3/2) and 32 + 64 log(3/2)); no reduction modulo total derivatives
twocomp.eta_killing: eps_alpha^i(x) = -i x_m sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} etabar^{alphadot i},  epsbar_{alphadot i}(x) = i x_m eta^alpha_i sigma^m_{alpha alphadot}; intrinsic vertex s0 = (A^{kj} eps_{alpha beta} eta^beta_j, lam^{*alpha}_k) - (A_kj eps_{betadot alphadot} etabar^{alphadot j}, lambdabar^{*betadot k})
twocomp.K_b: v^m = x^2 b^m - 2 (b.x) x^m; intrinsic z-polynomial vertex of Rem qs-twocomp with z = x - x_O
twocomp.D_1 scalar density: D_1 tr(... A_ij A_kl ...) adjacent density = -8u (1 - P + K/2) on the SO(6) indices of 1/4 w^{ij} A_ij (Upsilon^0_Delta ordered: same -8/3, exchanged 16, trace -8 per ordered word, planar factor 1/2; one-body -(22/3 + 2 theta) per A letter, theta = -1/3)
twocomp.D_1 bilinears: D_1 int omega w1^{ij} w2^{kl} (A_ij, A_kl)/16 = 0 (traceless), -48 u int omega (A_ij, A^{ij}) / 16 x (trace part)
twocomp.P_1: P_1(O) = -(1/3 + thetaP_perp) u b^m d_m O
twocomp.su(1|1): two-site D_1 density -8u (1 - Pi) on {Z = 1/4 w^{ij} A_ij, psi = lam_alpha^i component}, graded permutation Pi
twocomp.R7: D_1( int omega [(1/4 w1^{kl} A_kl, w2_{ji} xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + (1<->2)] ) = -16 u (1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij) int omega (A_{ji}, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j)

letters.D_n: n^m (d_m + [A_m, -]) with n = sigma^m_{1 1dot}: the null direction of the engine (n = (1,-i,0,0) in the engine frame)
letters.Z: Z = iota_w A = (1/4) w^{ij} A_ij, (w,w) = 0 (twist two, su(1|1))
letters.psi: psi = lambda_1^i (alpha = 1 component of lambda_alpha^i, fixed i)
letters.psi3, psi4: psi^(3) = lambda_1^3, psi^(4) = lambda_1^4: the alpha = 1 components with the two SU(4) labels other than those of the su(1|1) pair (engine SO(6) weights (-,+,+), (+,-,+))
letters.Z': Z' = A^{34} = (1/2) eps^{34kl} A_kl: the scalar with the SU(4) weight of lambda^3 lambda^4 (engine w' = e_4 - i e_5, read off from the A_perp output of Upsilon^0_Delta(psi3, psi4))
letters.F_11: F_11 = (sigma^m sigmabar^n)_1^gamma eps_{gamma 1} F_mn, F_mn = d_m A_n - d_n A_m + [A_m, A_n] (two-field part f = d_n A_m - d_m A_n with m = (0,0,1,i) in the engine frame; three-field part [A_n, A_m])

twocomp_fam.F3: tr(D_n^k Z D_n^{S-k} Z): D_1 = -32 h(S) u on the primaries, S even
twocomp_fam.F4: tr(D_n^k psi D_n^{S-k} psi): D_1 = -32 h(n+1) u, n odd
twocomp_fam.F5: tr(D_n^k lambda_1^3 D_n^{S-k} lambda_1^4) with tr(D_n^k A^{34} D_n^{S-k} F_11): D_1 = -8u x {0, 6, 25/3, 49/5, ...} (Prop c11-targets (iv))
twocomp_fam.F6: tr(D_n^k F_11 D_n^{S-k} F_11): D_1 = -32 h(n+2) u, n even
twocomp_fam.F7: tr(D_n^k F_11 D_n^{S-k} lambda_1^i): D_1 = -8u x {6, 25/3, 49/5, ...} (Prop c11-targets (v))
twocomp_fam.P_1: P_1 along n on F3-F7 (two-field part): sum Upsilon_{P_n} = -(1/3) u n^m d_m O, so P_1 = -(1/3 + theta_P) u n^m d_m O
twocomp_fam.one-body: per letter -(phi_X + 2 theta w_X) u at the action values theta = -1/3, phi_A = 22/3 (A_ij and A_m), phi_lambda = 47/3 (lambda_alpha^i, lambdabar_{alphadot i})
